tasks.label: Setup portfolio assets
tasks.command: mkdir -p assets/css pages public && cp -n *.png *.jpg public/ 2>/dev/null || true && ls -la public

tasks.label: Setup portfolio assets 2
tasks.command: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path assets/css,pages,public | Out-Null; Copy-Item *.png,*.jpg -Destination public -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem public

tasks.label: Fix CSS location
tasks.command: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path app/assets/css | Out-Null; Copy-Item assets/css/portfolio.css app/assets/css/portfolio.css -Force; Get-ChildItem app/assets/css

tasks.label: Move portfolio page into Nuxt app dir
tasks.command: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path app/pages | Out-Null; Copy-Item pages/index.vue app/pages/index.vue -Force; Get-ChildItem app/pages

tasks.label: Stop stale Nuxt dev server
tasks.command: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'nuxt dev' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force; Write-Output "Stopped $($p.ProcessId)" } else { Write-Output 'No process found' }
